title: FFmpeg Codecs Documentation
notes: Primary source for codec encoder options and documented option behavior.

title: FFmpeg Formats Documentation
notes: Primary source for MOV/MP4 muxer behavior, metadata placement, and fragmentation.

title: libx264 CRF mode
statement: The libx264 encoder uses crf to set the quality for constant quality mode.
excerpt: Set the quality for constant quality mode.

title: libx264 crf_max behavior
statement: In CRF mode, crf_max prevents VBV from lowering quality beyond the configured point.
excerpt: In CRF mode, prevents VBV from lowering quality beyond this point.

title: libx264 b_strategy pass scope
statement: The libx264 b_strategy option controls adaptive B-frame placement and is used only on the first pass.
excerpt: Adaptive B-frame placement decision algorithm. Use only on first-pass.

title: libx264 adaptive quantization modes
statement: The libx264 aq-mode option selects the adaptive quantization method. Documented methods include none, variance, and autovariance.
excerpt: Set AQ method. Possible values include none (0), variance (1), and autovariance (2).

title: libx264 HRD signaling requirement
statement: The libx264 nal-hrd option requires vbv-bufsize to be set.
excerpt: Set signal HRD information (requires vbv-bufsize to be set).

title: libx264 CBR HRD and MP4
statement: The libx264 nal-hrd=cbr mode is not allowed in the MP4 container.
excerpt: Constant bit rate (not allowed in MP4 container).

title: No fallback container is established by the indexed section
statement: The indexed FFmpeg section that prohibits libx264 nal-hrd=cbr in MP4 does not name a replacement container in that section.
excerpt: Constant bit rate (not allowed in MP4 container).

title: libx265 CRF mode
statement: The libx265 encoder uses crf to set the quality for constant quality mode.
excerpt: Set the quality for constant quality mode.

title: libx265 two-pass stats
statement: The libx265 x265-stats option names the two-pass stats file and is set automatically when -passlogfile is used.
excerpt: Specify the file name for 2-pass stats. This is set automatically when using the -passlogfile option.

title: MP4 faststart metadata placement
statement: MOV/MP4 metadata is normally at the end of the file; adding +faststart to -movflags moves it to the start for better playback.
excerpt: This is normally the case; it can be moved to the start for better playback by adding +faststart to the -movflags.

title: MP4 fragmentation controls
statement: MOV/MP4 fragmentation is enabled through muxer options such as movflags +frag_keyframe or movflags +frag_custom.
excerpt: Fragmentation is enabled by setting one of the options that define an interval.

name: MP4
notes: The FFmpeg formats documentation covers MOV/MP4 metadata placement and fragmentation behavior. Specific codec support still requires a compatible muxer and validated stream parameters.

title: Do not use libx264 nal-hrd=cbr in MP4
requirement: When targeting MP4, do not select libx264 nal-hrd=cbr because the FFmpeg documentation explicitly says that mode is not allowed in the MP4 container.

title: libx264 HRD signaling requires vbv-bufsize
requirement: Set vbv-bufsize whenever libx264 nal-hrd is used.

title: Use libx264 b_strategy only on the first pass
requirement: If b_strategy is used, keep it limited to the first pass as documented by FFmpeg.

title: Do not propose an unverified fallback container for nal-hrd=cbr
requirement: If the retrieved evidence does not establish a replacement container for libx264 nal-hrd=cbr, state that a fallback is not established instead of naming one.

title: Use faststart for MP4 progressive playback
requirement: Add -movflags +faststart when progressive playback matters, because this moves MOV/MP4 metadata to the start of the file.

name: Evidence-bounded MP4 delivery
audience: General MP4 delivery where every encoder option must be traceable to source material

constraints.label: HRD mode
constraints.value: Do not use nal-hrd=cbr in MP4

constraints.label: B-frame strategy
constraints.value: Use b_strategy only on the first pass

name: H.264 MP4 evidence-bounded recipe
objective: Produce an MP4 using only encoder behavior documented in the indexed FFmpeg sources.

steps.title: Inspect input
steps.details: Confirm the source streams and choose explicit video and audio handling before encoding.

steps.title: Encode H.264 video and AAC audio
steps.details: Use libx264 CRF mode and the AAC encoder. These options are documented independently; preset and pixel-format choices remain unset until a source supports them.

steps.title: Validate compatibility constraints
steps.details: Reject nal-hrd=cbr for MP4 and ensure vbv-bufsize is present if HRD signaling is used.

name: H.264 CRF plus VBV ceiling
objective: Use CRF while giving VBV a documented quality ceiling with crf_max.

steps.title: Encode with crf_max and VBV
steps.details: crf_max prevents VBV from lowering quality beyond the configured point in CRF mode. Supply the bitrate values from a verified delivery specification.

steps.title: Check HRD usage
steps.details: If nal-hrd is enabled, keep vbv-bufsize set and do not use cbr mode for MP4.

name: H.265 MP4 CRF probe
objective: Generate a minimal libx265 CRF command for evaluation without claiming unverified compatibility or efficiency.

steps.title: Encode with libx265 CRF
steps.details: The indexed FFmpeg source documents crf for libx265 constant quality mode. No broad playback compatibility claim is made by this recipe.

steps.title: Evaluate delivery separately
steps.details: Validate container compatibility, decoder support, and destination requirements before using the output in production.

title: Reject libx264 nal-hrd=cbr for MP4
context: A user requests MP4 delivery and considers CBR HRD signaling for libx264.
rationale: The indexed FFmpeg documentation explicitly states that nal-hrd=cbr is not allowed in the MP4 container.

title: Prefer faststart for progressive MP4 playback
context: Metadata placement is undecided and progressive playback is a requirement.
rationale: FFmpeg documents that +faststart moves MOV/MP4 metadata to the start of the file for better playback.

title: No fallback container is established for libx264 CBR HRD
context: A user asks whether to switch containers when nal-hrd=cbr is rejected for MP4.
rationale: The current evidence prohibits nal-hrd=cbr in MP4 but does not establish that another container supports it. The agent must request or ingest that evidence before recommending a fallback.
